explication: Newelle is a desktop virtual assistant: users chat through its interface and can extend conversations with model providers, tools, documents, web search, voice, and image generation. The controller is the central orchestration layer, while handler families implement provider-backed capabilities and utilities support context, media, downloads, and local models. The README documents product features; source excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX establish only some implementation relationships, so uncertain links are omitted or marked unverified.
